newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on short covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on short covering.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Sunday on covering of short positions ahead of settlement on Monday, dealers said.
They said speculation that the government might announce an IMF-inspired reformse package also prompted individuals to square their positions.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 11.50 points, or 0.85 percent, to close at 1,367.79. Losers led gainers 128 to 87.
Hub Power Co rose 0.35 to 31.30 rupees and Pak Suzuki Motor 3.50 to 43.50. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
